evidence.title: Evidence type
evidence.description: ABRA Flexi evidence path to extract

load_type.title: Load type
load_type.description: How this evidence is loaded on every run.

options.tooltip: **Incremental load** (default) — upserts records into the Storage table on the primary key. **Full load** — overwrites the table on every run. Both fetch the Date Start / Date End window on the chosen Date field; there is no automatic watermark, so bound an incremental load with a relative Date Start (e.g. '2 days ago') to fetch only recent changes.

date_field.title: Date field
date_field.description: Which date/datetime column the Date Start / Date End range filters on.

options.tooltip: Which date/datetime column the Date Start / Date End range filters on. Pick a column the evidence returns (e.g. `lastUpdate`, `datVyst`) or type one yourself. Default `lastUpdate`.

date_from.title: Date Start
date_from.description: Lower bound of the Date field range, applied on every run. For an incremental (upsert) load, set a relative bound like '2 days ago' to pull a rolling window of recent changes. Relative ('5 days ago') or absolute ('2026-01-01'). Empty = from the beginning.

date_to.title: Date End
date_to.description: Upper bound of the Date field range, applied on every run. Empty = now.

detail.title: Detail level
detail.description: How many fields each record includes. **Full** returns the complete record (all fields). **Summary** returns only the core identifying fields (e.g. id, code, name) — smaller and faster. **Custom** returns only the fields you list below.

custom_fields.title: Custom fields
custom_fields.description: Comma-separated field list (used when Detail level = custom)

custom_filter.title: Advanced WQL filter
custom_filter.description: Optional raw ABRA Flexi WQL, AND-ed into the Date Start / Date End window.

options.tooltip:
Raw **WQL** expression, written the way it appears inside the URL parentheses: `field operator 'value'`. It is combined with the Date Start / Date End window using `and`.

**Operators:** `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `like`, `is null`, `is empty`. Use `gt`/`lt` for ranges — the API rejects `ge`/`le`. Quote values with single quotes and use full ISO timestamps for dates.

**Examples:**
- `kod eq 'CODE-001'`
- `lastUpdate gt '2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00'`
- `kod eq 'A' and castka gt 1000`

Leave empty to fetch everything within the date window.

primary_key.title: Primary key
primary_key.description: Columns that uniquely identify a record. Leave empty to auto-detect.

options.tooltip: Columns that uniquely identify a record, used for incremental upsert. **Leave empty to auto-detect** from the evidence metadata (`id` on standard evidences, the evidence's own key such as `idUcetniDenik` on derived ones; report views load without a key). Pick columns from the list or type your own to override. Non-unique columns silently overwrite rows under incremental load. Changing the key of a table that already exists in Storage requires dropping the output table first.

Number of records fetched **per API request** (pagination page size). The extractor automatically pages through *all* matching records — this only controls how many are pulled per HTTP call. Higher values mean fewer requests but larger responses. Default `200`.
